description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex. No. 1847/38 of 30.01.2014, D/S Division, Moratuwa and Other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcel numbers, extents, servitude rights, and other land-related particulars. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, and modifications to title records, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
